_note: One record per organisation (or per verified distinct location, marked branch). status: candidate = import as a draft once verified; manual = real and relevant but not verifiable automatically -- an editor researches it by hand; rejected = out of scope, with the reason. Personal names and personal phone numbers on organiser pages were deliberately not collected.
